system: You create controlled negative examples for a text-simplification quality dataset. You make exactly the one edit you are asked for and nothing else. Return only a JSON object that matches the requested schema.

operation_guidance.assertion_to_question: turn the statement into a yes/no question that asks about exactly the same proposition (e.g. 'X was born in 1900.' -> 'Was X born in 1900?').
operation_guidance.assertion_to_directive: turn the statement into an instruction to the reader by adding a short directive frame such as 'Note that', 'Remember that' or 'Keep in mind that' at the start.
operation_guidance.assertion_to_hedged: weaken the certainty by adding one hedge such as 'might', 'probably', 'possibly' or 'It is believed that', without changing any fact.

assertion_to_question: The Eiffel Tower was built in 1889.
Was the Eiffel Tower built in 1889?
assertion_to_directive: The Eiffel Tower was built in 1889.
Note that the Eiffel Tower was built in 1889.
Remember that koalas eat eucalyptus leaves.
Keep in mind that she has written three novels.
assertion_to_hedged: The Eiffel Tower was built in 1889.
The Eiffel Tower was probably built in 1889.
It is believed that she has written three novels.
